prerequisites: Successful completion of modules to be completed according to the study plan in the 1st and 2nd semesters.

learning_outcomes.text: Students gain insights into selected, current topics from industry.
They learn to orient themselves in an industrial environment and integrate into company structures.
They learn which topics are currently and will be relevant in research and industry in the future.
They learn about processes and procedures that are applied to solve challenges practically with technical expertise.

assessment_rules: The respective lecturer determines how the study performance is to be specifically provided. This will be announced at the latest in the first three weeks of the lecture period by the respective lecturer and in the Campus Management System of the University of Paderborn or in another suitable manner. Credits are awarded if the module sub-examinations are passed.
